title: starwars-galaxy
description: StarWarsGalaxy is a Minecraft Spigot/Paper plugin currently in development that aims to deliver a Star Wars RPG experience with factions, Force abilities, lightsabers, planets, missions, and economy systems
body:
Star Wars Galaxy is a highly customizable Minecraft plugin developed by Noxant Games that recreates the Star Wars universe with immersive gameplay mechanics and roleplay features.

Players can choose their path as a Jedi, Sith, or other Star Wars-inspired characters, each offering a unique progression experience. The plugin includes a complete Force system that allows players to meditate, develop their connection to the Force, unlock new abilities, and master powerful techniques. Depending on their alignment and progression, players gain access to different skills, factions, and opportunities throughout the galaxy.

Travel plays a major role in the experience. Players can explore iconic planets such as Coruscant, Jedha, and Tatooine using an economy-based transportation system that requires credits to move between worlds. Certain planets are restricted based on the player's faction and alignment, meaning that Jedi and Sith may have access to different locations, creating a deeper sense of progression and immersion.

The plugin also features lightsabers, Force powers, custom progression systems, and famous droids such as C-3PO, BB-8, and R2-D2. Every aspect of the gameplay can be tailored to fit a server's needs, making Star Wars Galaxy an exceptional choice for both roleplay and adventure-focused communities.

With its detailed Force mechanics, faction-based exploration, economic systems, and extensive customization options, Star Wars Galaxy delivers an authentic and engaging Star Wars experience within Minecraft.
